h1.note: Technical completion under frozen recovery/budget policy, not quality. Pending records are not final failures.

h2.production_scope: new Gate/Critic/Optimizer retries only; excludes reused upstream and evaluator
h2.note: Known usage priced at frozen rates, not invoices. Reservations are separate budget records, never observed cost, imputed zero, or a CV bound.

h3.note: Few events remain reportable; no minimum of ten or power guarantee. Missing pairs prevent the full-cohort primary verdict. Transition counts only explain B-F; no additional hypothesis tests.
h3.scope: Fixed-AI controlled-mixture repair, not natural failure prevalence

paired_total_wilcoxon.note: Paired sum of four 1-5 scores, final minus initial. This tests a signed-rank location null, not H3's 30% boundary. Shared evolving memory and non-independent tasks limit reference inference; no causal interpretation.

latency.definition: Role distributions include successful, failed, and unresolved attempts; missing timings stay missing. Task call-sum adds direct production attempts including retries, excluding evaluator and batch Curator; it is not elapsed wall time. Wall-clock is first direct production attempt created_at to production_completed_at, including in-task waits and resumes; missing endpoints are undefined. Batch Curator is separately reported by role, never duplicated as task latency.

analysis_settings.sentence_rule: [.!?]+ followed by whitespace or end; minimum one for nonempty text
analysis_settings.syllable_rule: English vowel groups; subtract terminal e except le/ye when count>1; minimum one per word
analysis_settings.text_metric_note: Flesch ease=206.835-1.015(W/S)-84.6(Y/W); grade=.39(W/S)+11.8(Y/W)-15.59; lexical diversity=casefolded unique tokens/W. English heuristic, length-dependent; not evidence of factual truth or rubric validity.

report_provenance.note: O means a newly attempted API call in this cohort; success, reuse, quality, and task completion are distinct.
